Intake note (Commercial team, 07/09/2019). Our client Bhavana Fernandes is a 44-year-old civil engineer who lives at Flat 13C, Fatehgunj, Vadodara 390051 and can be reached on +91 89321 53608 or bhavana.fernandes68@example.in. The client's PAN KCRPF3813T.
The client consulted us about a breach of contract matter (Project Flamingo) against Lotus Motors Ltd. The breach of contract claim against M/s Lotus Motors Ltd is for Rs. 7,89,00,000; the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods.
